description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 score percentages for various datasets using different models, including MADLLM, MADLLM without feature embedding, MADLLM without skip embedding, and a baseline model labeled "pool". The horizontal axis lists the six datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the F1 score percentage, ranging from 60 to 100 in increments of 10. For each dataset, four bars are grouped together, colored green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM without feature embedding, blue for the "pool" model, and orange for MADLLM without skip embedding. The F1 scores for MADLLM are consistently high across all datasets, with values ranging from approximately 74 for WADI to 93 for SMD. The "pool" model has the lowest F1 scores, ranging from around 63 for WADI to 78 for SWaT. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the datasets or models, and no bars are visually emphasized.
